findings.body: Telegram media messages never copy ctx.message.reply_to_message.message_id into reply_to_message_id in the emitted envelope (media-ingestion.ts:125–163). After the bot finishes answering in a non-topic group, an allowed member replying with a photo, document, or voice message without a mention therefore fails every continuation check: group-trigger-policy.ts:85 requires the missing reply target. Preserve reply metadata for media messages so these replies reach the agent.
findings.title: Not done: Mention-required groups follow the conversation

findings.body: The unrelated-message check saves its message after all earlier turns have settled. It never saves a message while an unmentioned admission is still claimed but has not run an agent—the condition behind previous finding 2. The tests would still pass if 'claimed' were added to the state filter in live-admission-work-item-repository.postgres.ts:158. Add a Postgres regression proving that a message saved during such a rejected admission stays history and cannot enable a later turn.
findings.title: Not done: rejected-admission continuation regression test

findings.body: Normal channel persistence supplies agentId and providerAccountId but no agentSessionId (channel-persistence-handlers.ts:223–233). Consequently this null-session condition matches any running agent in the same chat and thread, without checking the admitted agent or account. While @Helper is running, a plain follow-up also gets receivedDuringTurn on @Planner's admission and can start Planner without a mention. Resolve the current admission's session scope before recording this flag.
findings.title: Scope the running-turn marker to the admitted agent and account

findings.body: Matching any route's textual trigger sets the shared mentionsBot flag. channel-persistence-handlers.ts:223–233 persists the same envelope for every matching route, and group-trigger-policy.ts:59 accepts that flag independently of the current route's trigger. In a group with @Helper and @Planner, '@Helper do this' therefore starts both agents. The same issue affects captions through media-ingestion.ts:140–146. Preserve route-specific trigger attribution instead of promoting a textual route match to a shared native-mention flag.
findings.title: Keep textual route triggers specific to their agent

findings.body: The thread lookup still reads only pageSize rows from the beginning. canonical-message-repository.postgres.ts:626–631 orders them ascending and applies the limit. If a topic has 200 human messages before the bot first replies, later unmentioned follow-ups never find that reply and remain history. Use a scoped outbound existence query or continue paging until a bot reply is found.
findings.title: Find bot replies beyond the first history page
